turns.replyText:
I completely understand how disappointing it can be to invest in a product that doesn't meet your expectations. Quality and durability are at the heart of everything we do at Tumble, and we've designed our rugs to handle real life without compromising on style. 🙂

What sets us apart is our commitment to high standards. All of our rugs and rug pads are OEKO-TEX® certified, meaning they've been tested for over 1,000 harmful substances, making them safe for your entire family, including pets and kids. We use a luxuriously soft, low-pile fabric that is naturally hypoallergenic and features a 100% spillproof coating. This causes liquids to bead up so you can simply wipe them away before they even become a stain!

Our rugs are also truly machine washable, even our largest 9x12' sizes fit into standard household washers. Plus, instead of finicky velcro that can lose its grip over time, we use a unique corner pocket system and a puzzle-piece cushioned pad to keep everything securely in place without corner curling.

If you'd like to see the quality for yourself before committing to a full-sized rug, you might find our Swatch program helpful! You can order 10” x 10” swatches to feel the texture and see the colors in your own home's lighting.

turns.replyText:
I understand that sometimes a product just isn't the right fit once you see it in your space. We want you to love your Tumble, so we offer a very flexible return and exchange policy to give you peace of mind. 🙂

You can return or exchange your item for any reason within 30 days of delivery. We even cover the shipping costs for the return! To be eligible, the item just needs to be in new and sellable condition, meaning it should be free from any visible damage, stains, or pet hair.

If you decide to go with an exchange, please keep in mind that our policy allows for one exchange per item. If the exchanged item still doesn't work out, you can return it for a full refund. Please note that rug swatches are considered final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged.
